name: 4-hydroxyvaleric acid
summary: γ-Hydroxyvaleric acid (GHV), also known as 4-methyl-GHB, is a designer drug related to γ-hydroxybutyric acid (GHB). It is sometimes seen on the grey market as a legal alternative to GHB, but with lower potency and higher toxicity, properties which have tended to limit its recreational use.

pharmacology.text: γ-Valerolactone (GVL) acts as a prodrug to GHV, analogously to how γ-butyrolactone (GBL) is a prodrug to GHB.

summaryZh: γ-羥基戊酸是一種羥基酸，是γ-羥基丁酸的相關設計藥物，可由γ-戊內酯生成。

sideEffects.en: Like GHB, it causes drowsiness, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, confusion and loss of coordination. It is reported to be more toxic than GHB, and loss of consciousness and slowed breathing are serious risks.
sideEffects.zh: 和GHB一樣，γ-羥基戊酸會引起嗜睡、頭暈、噁心、嘔吐、意識混亂與協調變差。據報告它的毒性比GHB更高，失去意識與呼吸變慢是嚴重的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 和GHB一样，γ-羟基戊酸会引起嗜睡、头晕、恶心、呕吐、意识混乱与协调制差。据报告它的毒性比GHB更高，失去意识与呼吸变慢是严重的风险。

fact.en: The body can make it from γ-valerolactone, a solvent made from plant waste that is being studied as a green fuel and is also used as a food flavouring.
fact.zh: 身體可以由γ-戊內酯轉化出γ-羥基戊酸。γ-戊內酯是由植物廢料製成的溶劑，正被研究作為綠色燃料，也被用作食品香料。
fact.zhHans: 身体可以由γ-戊内酯转化出γ-羟基戊酸。γ-戊内酯是由植物废料制成的溶剂，正被研究作为绿色燃料，也被用作食品香料。
